name: smwpatches-power-jumps
title: Power Jumps
description:
Made at request of: iRhyiku

Changes jump height based on powerup. Small Mario jumps low, big jumps regular, fire jumps high, and cape basically flies.

No credit necessary.



Removed some excess code that was totally irrelevant.

Note: Consider using the UberASM alternative, especially if you're going to use a custom status bar.
